title: Don't Let Me Get On The Train

lines.text: Don't let me get on the train.
[quiet, a small smile] Six days left. I spent the whole day watching the clock.
[softly] Same corner. Six-forty. And there he was.
lines.show: Same corner. 6:40. And there he was.

lines.text: [surprised, then a warm smile] Hey... you're the girl from the crosswalk. The car almost got you.
[quiet, a little hurt] He remembered the car... but not one of his messages.
[softly, smiling] We both reached for the last cookie... and neither of us let go.
[quiet, a shy smile] Half? ...You can have the bigger one.
[teasing, smiling] Then why are you still holding it?
[warm] We talked until they closed the café.
[softer] Then I noticed his watch. Stopped at eleven eleven.
lines.show: Then I noticed his watch. Stopped at 11:11.

lines.text: [quiet, a little sad] It stopped the night my brother died. I never fixed it.
[warm, a little wistful] We said goodbye at the door. I smiled the whole way home.
[low, uneasy] At eleven eleven... my phone lit up.
[urgent, low, out of breath] Mira. You found me, didn't you? Tomorrow... don't let me get on the train.
[almost a whisper, voice breaking] Because if I get on that train... you're the one who doesn't come home.
